study_identification_part.si_4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study proposes macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) using a convolutional variational autoencoder (ConVAE) with 1D convolutional layers. The VAE model learns patterns of macrostructural (tract shape and geometry) and microstructural variation in a healthy population. The encoder consists of four 1D depth-wise separable convolutional layers (kernel size 15, channels 32/64/128/256), and the decoder consists of three layers (kernel size 15, channels 128/96/64). The model was trained with ELBO loss and cyclical annealing on KL divergence. Linear regression was used for group difference testing (MAE ~ Age + Sex + DX).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: In MINT, we use 1D convolutional layers to model streamline-level information... VAE is considered to be one of many non-linear extensions of dimensionality reduction methods... We previously showed that using this approach, a VAE with 1D convolutional layers (ConvVAE) preserves streamline and bundle distances in the latent space... Overall, the VAE model consists of 464,408 parameters: the encoder consists of four 1D SepConv layers with kernel sizes of 15
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Section 2.3 Macrostructure-informed normative tractometry / 2.3.1 Macrostructure modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study models four standard DTI microstructural measures: fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), radial diffusivity (RD), and axial diffusivity (AxD). These DTI metrics are projected onto the 3D streamline coordinates from tractography. Additionally, MINT derives deviation scores (MAE-FA, MAE-MD, MAE-RD, MAE-AxD, MAE-Shape) from reconstruction error.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: DTI metrics, FA, MD, RD, and AxD, were projected onto the corresponding bundle in the native space... we also calculated the mean along-tract profile M... where the features contain four DTI measures... MINT can learn the patterns of statistical variation in whole-brain macrostructure by training it on streamlines (3D curves) from multiple bundles

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as covariates in both the ComBat harmonization step and the linear regression models for group difference testing. Site/protocol effects were handled through ComBat harmonization across 7 ADNI protocols and 2 NIMHANS scanners. The statistical model was: MAE ~ Age + Sex + DX (diagnosis).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Covariates can also be specified in ComBat to preserve the known biological variability across subjects (eg, age and sex). In this study, ComBat was run for each of the 30 bundles and nine features, by pooling information across 100 segments of each bundle, with age and sex modeled as covariates... A linear regression model was fitted for each of the 100 segments in 30 bundles with harmonized diffusion metrics modeled as the dependent variable, and diagnosis (DX), age, and sex as independent variables (MAE ~ Age + Sex + DX, M ~ Age + Sex + DX)
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Section 2.3.3 Bundle profiling; Section 2.4 Statistical analysis of diagnostic group differences
